correctness.rationale: All hypotheses n>=d>=3 and the canonical Newton coordinates are explicit. Using the published exact normal-ray set, the proof computes all support offsets independently and reduces the ball feasibility system to adjacent difference constraints, controlled by a sharp chain and coordinate bound. A discrete-concavity lemma proves those bounds sufficient, and strict inequalities yield the center phase transition. Standalone independent numerical optimization corroborates the all-parameter proof (12,551 support checks and 55 LP optima). Main residual correctness dependency is accurate published facet-ray premise.

value.rationale: The two-parameter Catalan pellytope family is a natural interpolation of hypercube/pellytope/associahedron. The theorem gives the exact Euclidean inradius in the original embedding, an explicit sharp integer threshold, a unique-center regime with n+1 contacts, and a high-dimensional incenter phase admitting only four generic contacts. This is a structural change not implied by its known fan, vertex counts, or abstract combinatorial equivalence.
